There are 5 sheets in the pack, and each sheet has 16 stickers. How many stickers are in the pack?
A rectangle is 6 feet by 15 feet. What is the area of the rectangle? Explain or show your reasoning.

What is the difference in square inches between the area of last year’s banner and this year’s banner?
